title: TARAZ: Persian Short-Answer Question Benchmark for Cultural Evaluation of Language Models
findings: The study found that social-behavioral and ritual domains were among the most difficult for the models. However, the best-performing model, GPT-5, still maintained high accuracy (82.8%) in the 'Rituals' category on the PerCul dataset.
